div.head: Grið 11
div.ab: 7 gyf hwa cynges mundbrice elles gewyrce, gebete þæt mid V pundum on Engla lage, arcebiscopes 7 æþelinges mundbrice mid þrim pundum, oðres biscpæs 7 ealdormannes mid II pundum.
And gyf hwa cynges mundbrice elles gewyrce, gebete þæt mid V pundum on Engla lage, arcebiscopes and æþelinges mundbrice mid þrim pundum; oðres biscpæs and ealdormannes mid II pundum.

Und wenn einer anderweitig Verletzung königlicher Schutzgewalt verübt, büsse er dies im Engländer-Recht mit 5 Pfund, Verletzung der Schutzgewalt eines Erzbischofs und [= oder] eines Prinzen mit 3 Pfund, die eines anderen Bischofs und [= oder] eines Ealdorman mit 2 Pfund.

And if anyone otherwise commits breach of the king's protection, let him atone for it under English law with 5 pounds; breach of the protection of an archbishop and [= or] of a prince with 3 pounds; that of another bishop and [= or] of an ealdorman with 2 pounds.

And if anyone otherwise violates the king’s protection, he is to compensate for that with five pounds according to English law; violation of an archbishop’s and nobleman’s protection with three pounds; another bishop’s and ealdorman’s with two pounds.

note.label: closer to original
note.quote: the form of the equivalent law in Grið 11 is in some ways closer to Alfred's original

div.note: ‘English law’ here means the law of the southern English (9), Liebermann notes. Liebermann compares II Cn 58–58.2 and Af 3.
